methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: In this paper a preliminary energy analysis on the possibility to hybridise a solar cooling HVAC system has been presented.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Thermodynamic dynamic-simulation (MATLAB/Simulink) energy analysis of a hybrid solar-cooling HVAC system for building services; reports system-efficiency indicators (COP thermal/electrical, heat recovery fraction, thermal solar fraction). It does not present or characterise an EnPI/EnB energy-performance-measurement model: no energy baseline, no relevant-variable normalisation, no ISO 50001/50006 or M&V content. Borderline because it does define named energy performance indicators with functional forms.

paper_type.evidence_quote: A MATLAB SIMULINK model has been built and dynamic simulations when outdoor environmental conditions change have been performed.

stage1.notes: Borderline: solar-cooling HVAC dynamic-simulation study; reports COP-type indicators but no ISO 50006 EnPI/EnB baseline, relevant-variable normalisation or M&V. Flag for human adjudication.
